_note: [SEED] M11 combat register — the in-voice combat SURFACE (directive §4: all verbs + outcomes render through the register engine's prose, no menu-speak). labels: the short verb names on the choice line (not 'fight/talk/flee'). beats: the voiced line after an action resolves. outcomes: the banner when a fight ends or a verb is refused. subterfuge: the environment-keyed edge the SUBTERFUGE verb reads per-biome. All strings [SEED] until Ray's voice pass; stripped from every player surface at draw.

defend: [SEED] you set your feet and wait for it
subterfuge: [SEED] you work the ground for a lie
flee: [SEED] you look for a lane out

[SEED] you meet it without looking away

[SEED] you show it the mask it cannot wear

[SEED] you name a price that costs you nothing yet

_targeting_note: [SEED] M12 H3 — the follower-targeting weight table. Ships EXACTLY uniform {pc:1, follower:1} so combat is unchanged; a later operator pass can raise follower to make allies drawn fire, or pc to make the stranger the mark. A tunable design lever, not an array-order accident.
